mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.payment ( branchid, goodsid, type, startdate, enddate, price, memberid, userid, regdate ) VALUES ( #{session_branchid}, #{goodsid}, #{type}, #{startdate}, #{enddate}, ${price}, #{memberid}, #{userid}, now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ttokssaemdb.payment SET canceluserid = #{session_userid}, cancel = 'Y', canceldate = now() WHERE paymentid = ${paymentid}
mapper.select: SELECT 'background' as display, 'false' as overlap, CONCAT(SUBSTR(startdate, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(startdate, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(startdate, 7, 2)) start FROM ttokssaemdb.payment WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND regdate BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
